title: NodeRun
description: The durable record of one node attempt (ADR-0008 §7). Identity is the four-part key (runId, nodeId, iteration, attempt) fixed by ADR-0021 §1. Records are never overwritten by a retry: each attempt keeps its own record, because evaluation depends on being able to see how failures evolved.

schemaVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: stored documents are versioned as data. One version exists in V1.

status.description: ADR-0008 §7. INDETERMINATE is entered when a write-ahead intent record exists with no matching outcome: a side effect may or may not have occurred. Most workflow engines omit this state and then discover they need it after posting two pull requests for the same issue.

capabilityGrantId.description: The grant minted for this attempt. A retry gets a fresh grant, so a failed attempt leaves no residual authority behind.

claimedOutput.description: What the runtime reported. Not authoritative: ADR-0004 §9 requires the control plane to validate it against the node's declared output schema before any transition is evaluated.

validatedOutput.description: claimedOutput after successful schema validation. Only this may be referenced by edge conditions.

stopReason.description: Why a loop node stopped iterating (ADR-0021 §4). Recording which bound fired is what makes 'the loop burned the budget' diagnosable without reading logs. Present only on loop nodes; the iteration count is derivable from the NodeRun records and is deliberately not denormalised here, where it could disagree with them.

indeterminateReason.description: Populated only when status is INDETERMINATE. ADR-0008 Security Impact: this must be visible to an operator. A silently swallowed indeterminate side effect is worse than a loud failure.
